tagline: Omnichannel department store leader transforming the shopping experience
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI is the primary driver of the current physical transformation and customer strategy, with direct impact on comparable sales performance. This store reinvention program captures the revitalization of the store portfolio and enhances customer experience, representative of the strategic renewal 'Bold New Chapter'.

kpis.name: Reimagined stores (125)
kpis.explanation: Number of Macy's stores reimagined with new customer experience and improved store layout.
kpis.description: The 125 reimagined stores were created by layering successful initiatives from the 'First 50' across 75 additional stores. They outperformed the rest of the portfolio in 2025.
kpis.signal: WOW: these stores outperform the rest of the network.

kpis.name: Comparable sales
kpis.explanation: Sales growth from stores open for more than one year, including online sales.
kpis.description: Comparable sales increased 1.5% in 2025 versus -0.9% in 2024, on an owned-plus-licensed-plus-marketplace basis.
kpis.signal: Positive rebound after two years of decline.

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between sales and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Gross margin declined 40 basis points in 2025, primarily due to tariff impact, despite mitigation efforts.

kpis.name: Operating margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin improved to 4.6% in 2025 versus 4.0% in 2024, driven by SG&A reduction and efficiency gains.

kpis.name: Digital sales
kpis.explanation: Share of sales generated online in total sales.
kpis.description: Digital sales represented 35% of total sales in 2025 versus 33% in 2024, demonstrating continued adoption of the omnichannel model.

kpis.name: Total assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the past four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 16.24 bn € in the last year

kpis.name: Total debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the past four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 5.2 bn € in the last year

kpis.name: Cash and equivalents
kpis.description: Cash and equivalents extracted from yfinance over the past four years.
kpis.signal: Cash and equivalents of 1.25 bn € in the last year

kpis.name: Bloomingdale's comparable sales
kpis.explanation: Comparable sales growth of the group's luxury brand.
kpis.description: Bloomingdale's achieved its strongest comparable sales growth in 14 quarters, driven by fragrances, luxury apparel, and jewelry.

kpis.name: Bluemercury comparable sales
kpis.explanation: Comparable sales growth of the high-end cosmetics chain.
kpis.description: Bluemercury recorded its 20th consecutive quarterly growth, supported by strengthened partnerships in dermatological skincare and fragrances.

risks.title: Failure of Bold New Chapter strategy
risks.score_rationale: Risk is central in the 10-K, mentioned at the start of risk factors. Language emphasizes 'material adverse' impact if strategy fails. The strategy structures all future investments. Highly weighted strategic category.

risks.title: Increased competition, particularly digital
risks.score_rationale: Repeatedly mentioned across multiple sections with strong language ('significant competition', 'lose competitive advantage'). Rise of e-commerce and AI among competitors is highlighted. Structural risk to business model.

risks.title: Difficulty anticipating consumer trends
risks.score_rationale: High position in document, direct link to demand and margin. Concerned language ('difficult to predict', 'lose market share'). Reinforced by growing expectations around personalization and sustainability.

risks.title: Inventory shortages or excess
risks.score_rationale: Directly linked to profitability ('negatively impacts gross margins'). Explicit mention of risks from over-estimating and under-estimating demand. Direct impact on operating results.

risks.title: Dependence on private label credit cards
risks.score_rationale: Significant revenue (3.1% of sales) with contract through 2030. Recent regulatory risk (late fees). Vulnerability to alternative payment methods (BNPL).

risks.title: Recruitment difficulties and wage cost pressures
risks.score_rationale: Frequent mention of labor shortages, competitive wages, and rising costs. Linked to operating performance. Tight macroeconomic context (low unemployment).

risks.title: Reputational risk via social media
risks.score_rationale: Alarmist language ('harm could be immediate', 'adverse publicity'). Risk amplified by social media. Mention of serious incidents (shootings, accidents). High position in document.

ai_positioning.summary: Company M does not mention artificial intelligence in its 10-K/20-F report.
